purpose: Development-only mechanism pilot before any calibration or test access
truth_use: Source truth was used only to choose four contrasting development mechanisms; each event-specific candidate design was generated without reading truth.

profile_design.center: minimum-best_raw_loss endpoint from the frozen six-start inversion
profile_design.nuisance_initialization: warm-start all non-location model state from the frozen selected multistart checkpoint, then reset and lock source coordinates at each candidate

promotion_rule: Do not enter calibration. First require a prespecified profile-geometry summary to rank the selected-success case as safer than both the reachability-failure and selection-failure cases without using concentration fit alone. If this fails, retain the pilot as a negative result and redesign or drop the selective claim before expanding nuisance seeds or all development scenarios.
prohibited_interpretations: delta profile loss is not a posterior probability
the four development cases do not estimate generalization performance
no threshold may be transferred to calibration or test from this pilot alone
